locator: §4.1, 4.1.1 A logic of attitudes, 'One line of thought is that these proposals conflate genuine inconsistency with mere pragmatic incoherence'
interpretation: The cognitivist objection to the logic-of-attitudes strategy (Hale 1986; Schueler 1988; Brighouse 1990; Zangwill 1992; van Roojen 1996): a clash of attitudes is pragmatic incoherence, not logical inconsistency, so it does not explain why the argument is valid. The entry notes that non-cognitivists have replied with more sophisticated proposals; the objection is recorded as an attack, not as a refutation. Attribution reading on a secondary witness: the claim records the position the entry reports, not a thesis of the entry's author. No primary text is pinnable (in copyright, no immutable open text).
